$comment: CANONICAL list of URL paths the mobile app is allowed to capture from
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: iOS and Android filter deep-link paths on opposite
sides of the wire. iOS reads a server-hosted apple-app-site-association
whose `components` array does the filtering; Android's assetlinks.json has
NO path concept at all, so filtering must be declared in the app's own
manifest (intentFilters -> pathPrefix) in app.config.js. Because the two
controls live in different repos, they drifted: the iOS allowlist was
written carefully while the Android filter was left claiming the WHOLE
domain — including /auth/callback and the password flows that iOS
Both platforms now derive their config from this file. Do not hand-edit
NOTE: changing this requires a native EAS rebuild to take effect on
Android (it writes AndroidManifest.xml). JS-only OTA updates do not
`exact`    -> the bare path itself is app-handled (/jobs)
